title: 9 Best AI Front Desk Software Tools for Hotels in 2026
summary: Nine AI front desk tools for hotels compared on phone calls, messaging, check-in, staff routing and PMS actions, with 60-room pricing where published.
body_markdown:
The AI front desk software worth shortlisting for hotels in 2026 is Akia, Canary Technologies, Conduit and HelloShift if you want one vendor for the whole desk, and Aiello, Asksuite, Bookboost, Duve or HiJiffy if you want to automate part of it. The split comes from how many of five front desk jobs (calls, messaging, check-in, staff routing and PMS actions) each runs with its own product.


## How did we order this list?


Vendor order follows how many of the five front desk jobs each vendor publishes as its own product, with ties broken alphabetically. A PMS action means a write, such as booking a room or posting a charge, and check-in run by a partner does not count. Akia, Canary Technologies, Conduit (our product) and HelloShift publish all five. Aiello, Asksuite, Bookboost, Duve and HiJiffy each publish three, a different three in each case, so they follow in alphabetical order. Facts come from vendor pages read November 26, 2026.


## Which AI front desk tools cover calls, messages, check-in and PMS actions?


AI front desk tools that cover calls, messages, check-in, request routing and PMS actions with their own products are Akia, Canary Technologies, Conduit and HelloShift. Each answers the phone on the same system that handles guest messages, and each publishes a way to book or charge against the reservation. The other five cover three of the jobs each, through phone routing, messaging and check-in, or pre-booking chat.


### 1. Akia


[Akia](https://www.akia.com/) runs one agent across calls and messaging to book rooms and text PCI-compliant payment links mid-call. On a call it matches the caller's number to the reservation in hotel PMSs such as Mews, Cloudbeds and StayNTouch, and it warm-transfers to the front desk, maintenance, housekeeping or the manager on duty with a summary. Akia covers digital check-in, unified messaging (SMS, email, web, OTA, WhatsApp, social), and upsells that post to the folio and rewrite the room type. Akia says up to 90% of messages never reach your team, and Bellmoor Inn & Spa automates 86% of its guest communication.


Pricing: Custom quote (Basic, Pro, and Max with AI Voice and call transfers).


Fit: Independent hotels on Mews, Cloudbeds, or StayNTouch wanting voice, messaging, check-in, and folio upsells together.


### 2. Canary Technologies


[Canary Technologies](https://www.canarytechnologies.com/products/ai-voice-hotels) launched AI Voice on February 5, 2025 (AI Front Desk, Concierge, Central Reservations, Booking Agent). One model spans call, text, and chat to book, modify, upsell, and route calls across PMS, CRS, CRM, booking engine, and payments. Tiers add Mobile Check-In, Tablet Registration, Smart Checkout, AI tickets, and SMS, WhatsApp, LINE, and WeChat. Canary serves 20,000+ hotels in 125+ countries and says AI Guest Messaging responds to more than 80% of guest inquiries in 100+ languages.


Pricing: Custom quote across Core, Advanced, and Pro (AI Webchat).


Fit: Hotels and groups wanting check-in, check-out, multilingual messaging, service tickets, and voice from one vendor.


### 3. Conduit


[Conduit](https://www.conduit.ai/industry/independent-hotels/front-desk) runs inbound and outbound Voice AI on the same agent as an inbox for OTA, SMS, WhatsApp and email messages, and it writes back to connected PMSs. Escalations reach staff with the full conversation attached,[guest portals](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/portals) (Guest package) handle check-in, upsells and one-click payments, and on Full Suite an internal ops agent dispatches housekeeping and maintenance. The agent works in 140+ languages.


Pricing: starting rates per unit, with volume pricing past 50 units. Messaging from $18/unit/mo (Voice AI, inbox, PMS/OTA sync, escalations); Guest from $30 (portals, upsells); Full Suite from $48 (cleaning, maintenance, inspections, dispatch).


Conduit: best for independent hotels and hotel groups that want calls, messages and staff requests on one agent because it automates 70 to 90% of guest conversations once fully deployed.


### 4. HelloShift


[HelloShift](https://www.helloshift.com/ai-voice) bundles guest messaging and website chat, Contactless Checkin, an AI Assistant and AI Voice for overflow and after-hours calls. Across 40+ PMS systems and 100+ languages, AI Voice checks real-time availability, books rooms, texts a card link mid-call, and saves recordings and transcripts in the inbox. Pro adds housekeeping, maintenance, and staff collaboration. HelloShift reports 70 to 82% of routine calls automated.


Pricing: Guest+ $2.50/room/mo annual ($3.50 monthly); Pro $4.00 ($5.60 monthly); 40-room min, 14-day trial, no setup fee or AI credits.


Fit: Hotels that want published per-room pricing for contactless check-in, overflow voice and housekeeping tools in one product.


### 5. Aiello


[Aiello](https://www.aiello.ai/) serves 30,000+ rooms in 9 countries from Taipei. Its AI Call Agent connects via PBX for inbound and outbound calls, checks guest details and availability in the PMS and CRS, routes departmental calls, and logs TMS Pro tasks while transferring emergencies and payments to staff.[GuestWeb](https://www.aiello.ai/products/guestweb) , opened from an in-room QR code, adds an AI chat concierge in 58+ languages for questions, service requests and bookings. Aiello reports that at Crowne Plaza Changi Airport it handles 50% of routine daily calls autonomously, routing the rest across 16 departments.


Pricing: Not published.


Fit: Full-service hotels needing multi-department call routing and in-room chat, with check-in handled by another tool.


### 6. Asksuite


[Asksuite](https://asksuite.com/sophia-ai/) runs Sophia AI 24/7 in 50+ languages across WhatsApp, Instagram, Messenger, Telegram, web chat, and voice messages on supported channels. Sophia AI quotes rates in the chat through 400+ booking engine integrations and hands threads to staff in the same inbox, and AskFlow Agents include a Check-in and Check-out Agent. Asksuite says 5,800+ properties use it, and its pages show no phone-answering product.


Pricing: Not published.


Fit: Hotels prioritizing 24/7 pre-booking chat and direct quotes across web and messaging apps.


### 7. Bookboost


[Bookboost](https://www.bookboost.io/pricing) builds on a hospitality CDP with 80+ PMS integrations and adds modules: a unified Inbox for messaging, OTAs and routing, a Journey builder, Broadcasts, and a Guest App add-on for online check-in and check-out. Bee AI answers in the Inbox, with draft mode free and the first 150 autonomously resolved conversations free before a flat per-room fee. Bookboost publishes no phone product.


Pricing: CDP €2.20, Journey €2.80, Inbox €2.80 per room per month, so CDP, Journey and Inbox together start at €7.80/room; Guest App €1.40/room (requires Journey); €399 monthly minimum; paid Bee AI rate not published.


Fit: Hotels building pre-stay journeys, OTA routing, and digital check-in around one CRM.


### 8. Duve


[Duve](https://duve.com/pricing/) centers on online check-in (document scans, e-signature registration cards, payments, deposits), a branded guest app, check-out, and a Communication Hub with OTA messaging on Pro. Upsells sit on Premium and write back to Opera, Mews and other supported PMS folios, and Duve says it can go live in as little as 10 days. Duve does not publish a phone product, so calls stay with staff or a voice provider.


Pricing: Minimum monthly packages of $120 (Basic), $150 (Pro), and $200 (Premium).


Fit: Properties that want online check-in, a branded guest app and OTA messaging, with calls covered elsewhere.


### 9. HiJiffy


[HiJiffy](https://www.hijiffy.com/) automates web, social, WhatsApp, email, and OTA messaging across 2,600+ hotels and 100+ integrations. HiJiffy states its AI handles up to 90% of conversations and routes the rest to staff with context and suggested replies. On Premium, in-house requests go to the right team, and with a supported PMS, guests pay for upsells by link and the payment posts to the reservation. Premium's digital check-in is a WhatsApp campaign, with ID-scan check-in supplied by a partner. Voice partners such as Bookline.ai answer phone calls and hand off to HiJiffy for WhatsApp follow-up, and HiJiffy's own voicebot handles voice messages in chat.


Pricing: Basic from €99, $109 or £99 a month by region, scaled by room count; Premium from $359 or £319 a month.


Fit: Hotels wanting web, OTA, and WhatsApp chat automation paired with a voice partner.

## What does AI front desk software cost for a 60-room hotel?


A 60-room hotel can calculate its monthly price from published rates for three of the nine vendors: HelloShift from $150, Bookboost from €468 and Conduit from $1,080 if each room is billed as one unit. Duve and HiJiffy publish minimums or starting prices rather than a 60-room figure, and Akia, Aiello, Asksuite and Canary Technologies quote privately.


- HelloShift: Guest+, which includes AI Voice, is $150 a month billed annually or $210 billed monthly (60 × $2.50 or $3.50); Pro is $240 annually or $336 monthly.
- Bookboost: CDP, Journey and Inbox come to €468 a month (60 × €7.80), above the €399 minimum. The Guest App for online check-in adds €84 (60 × €1.40), and Bee AI's paid autonomous rate is not published.
- Duve: a hotel that wants OTA messaging alongside check-in starts at the $150 Pro minimum, and upsells need Premium at a $200 minimum; Duve does not publish what a 60-room property pays above those floors.
- HiJiffy: Premium, which carries WhatsApp and the PMS integration, starts at $359 or £319 a month and rises with room count; the 60-room figure is not shown.
- Conduit: at starting rates, Messaging is $1,080 a month for 60 units (60 × $18), Guest $1,800 and Full Suite $2,880, with volume pricing past 50 units. Messaging already includes inbound and outbound Voice AI.


## Which front desk job should you automate first?


The front desk job to automate first is whichever one costs your hotel the most bookings or staff hours today. AI phone answering comes first if callers hit voicemail during check-in rushes or night shifts; Canary Technologies states up to 40% of hotel calls go unanswered. Messaging automation takes priority when OTA threads, WhatsApp, and SMS sit unread. When lobby queues and registration cards slow arrivals, online check-in clears the desk. Properties relaying housekeeping and maintenance by phone or radio gain most from internal routing; Aiello's call agent, for one, turns a spoken request into a task in its TMS Pro system for the right department.


## What should you test in a demo?


A demo of AI front desk software should prove five things on a sandbox reservation: a PMS change made by phone, a request that reaches housekeeping, one thread across call and text, a clean handoff to a person, and a check-in that shows up in the PMS. Run these before signing.


1. Phone in and ask to move your arrival date, then check whether the change appears on the reservation in your PMS.
2. Send a WhatsApp asking for extra towels and see whether a task reaches housekeeping.
3. Call, hang up, then text from the same number. Both should land in one thread.
4. Ask a billing question the AI should not answer, and check that the person who takes over gets a summary and the transcript.
5. Complete online check-in with an ID scan and confirm the PMS shows the guest as pre-registered.


For background on how these assistants work day to day, see our guide to[AI front desk assistants](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/ai-front-desk-assistant-what-it-is-and-how-hotels-are-using-it) , and for phone-only tools, the list of[AI receptionist software for independent hotels](https://www.conduit.ai/blog/best-ai-receptionist-software-independent-hotels) .


## FAQ


Hotel managers comparing AI front desk tools usually ask six things: what the software does, whether it takes calls, whether it replaces staff, what it costs, which vendors publish prices and how each tool works with a hotel PMS. Vendor prices and features change often, so a demo or a written quote should confirm anything that decides a purchase.


### What is AI front desk software?


AI front desk software answers hotel calls and guest messages, runs online check-in and check-out, sends requests to the right department and updates the PMS. Routine questions get answered automatically, and anything unusual goes to staff with the conversation attached.


### Can AI front desk software answer the phone?


Yes, if the vendor has its own voice product. Akia, Canary Technologies, Conduit, HelloShift and Aiello publish native AI phone answering, while the messaging-led tools on this list use a voice partner or leave calls to staff.


### Does AI front desk software replace front desk staff?


No. Staff keep in-person service and the exceptions, and the software takes repeat questions and request routing. Every vendor on this list publishes a way to hand a conversation the AI cannot resolve to a person.


### How much does AI front desk software cost?


For a 60-room hotel, the lowest calculable published plan with AI phone answering is HelloShift Guest+ at $150 a month on annual billing. Bookboost and Conduit also publish rates you can multiply out, Duve and HiJiffy publish minimums or starting prices, and four vendors quote privately.


### Which AI front desk tools publish pricing?


Five of the nine vendors publish pricing: Bookboost, Conduit, Duve, HelloShift and HiJiffy. Akia, Aiello, Asksuite and Canary Technologies quote privately.


### Does AI front desk software work with my PMS?


Most of these vendors connect to hotel PMSs, but what each one can write back differs. Akia, Duve and HiJiffy publish posting charges to the reservation, Canary and HelloShift publish booking rooms on a call, Conduit writes back to connected PMSs, and Bookboost does not state write actions. Ask for a live write-back on your own PMS.
